title: Adopt the example-driven workflow
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. 0001 names the retired meaning-holder.
decision: Cratylus ships the example-driven workflow: the meaning is a conceptual design per bounded context; before any build, concepts are illustrated as concrete examples (given, when, then), approved by the architect and frozen, with a share held out; builders iterate until the visible examples pass; one judgment runs the held-out examples and independent assayers judge what cannot execute; one whole check; the lead integrates; the operator releases. It composes established practice: specification by example, domain-driven design, test-driven development and held-out evaluation.
consequences: The record now states this as the founding decision.
